focused.command: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_v24917_read_reuse.py tests/test_v24917_genfix1_adapter.py tests/test_v24917_targeted_catchup.py

findings.defect: Readonly flags were applied to arrays returned by the parent without ensuring ownership; shared producer buffers could be frozen or subsequently alter cached data.
findings.fix: Cache owned C-contiguous float64 copies, verify the read epoch after copying, and make only those copies readonly.

findings.defect: Invalid or unusable arrays could be cached before reduction, poisoning another profile that should perform a fresh native read.
findings.fix: Do not retain failed conversion, wrong shape, nonfinite, negative or all-zero read results. Return original values to the sealed reducer, retaining its validation and tiny-negative clipping semantics. Full inherited-build regressions prove later profiles can recover after NaN/zero reads.

findings.defect: Unsupported direction scopes, skipped by the parent builder, could falsely mark a single-use link/DSeg as shared.
findings.fix: Only count selected profiles with one or two directed keys, matching the parent execution scope.

reviewed_contracts: 11D verified metric reuse and byte-equal CSV output
Generation design-local reuse, epoch/config/zone invalidation and nested exception cleanup
FlowBundle direction/DSeg identity, four-entry LRU, ownership, failed-read retry and build-local cleanup
TD one read per unique directed link per live call; no volume cache across calls
NumPy/tuple reducer parity and unchanged legacy reducer errors/clipping
cache_limit_scope: Retained cache entries; not a bound on total process memory or temporary active computation buffers.
limitations: Real COM speedup and whole-process peak memory were not measured.
